title: Mexican Tarte Tatin
description: A twist on the classic French dessert, with the bold flavors of Mexico. The sweetness of the tarte meets the spiciness of the Mexican chili powder.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the honey, chili powder, and cumin.
Spread the honey mixture evenly over the center of the puff pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the honey mixture with the crumbled burrata cheese.
Fold the edges of the puff pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Transfer the tarte to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the tarte from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the top of the tarte before serving.
